(Currently amended) A computer-implemented method for trading combinations of financial instruments, said method comprising: receiving, during a selected time period, combination orders to trade financial instruments; storing each eligible received combination order, wherein a received combination order is eligible if it satisfies at least one selected condition, wherein said at least one selected condition includes the necessary condition that all financial instruments specified by the legs of an eligible order are in a set of two or more selected financial instruments; and __processing, by a computer processor, eligible orders or expanded eligible orders with a combinatorial matching algorithm (CMA) executed on said computer processor__, wherein said processing begins at a selected time.
